decision: The entire upstream change replaces a zone-stability initial wait with afterNextRender, uses an initialized subject for subscriptions before the view query, and changes the subscription callback zone boundary, alongside extensive test timing revisions. Owned legacy independently uses an initialized subject with destroy completion and retains a guarded hybrid of onStable and afterNextRender, with cancellation and delayed option-change handling. Its closing-action getter remains outside the zone.run reset callback, so the modern refactor is not copied wholesale. The historical zoneful ordering remains deliberate and this source decision does not assert universal scheduling equivalence.

whole_hunk_analysis.upstream: The complete production hunks add initialized subject and Injector, replace zone-only option subscription and first stability wait with initialized and afterNextRender, and move the getter expression into the zone.run callback. The complete test diff removes MockNgZone, replaces many fakeAsync/zone exits with asynchronous render waits, and adjusts position, selection and close tests; these are general timing changes, not dismissed as MDC styling.
whole_hunk_analysis.current: optionSelections defers to initialized before the autocomplete query and completes initialization on view init or destruction. firstStable races onStable and afterNextRender guarded by zone.isStable and unsubscribes/destroys the losing hook. Query-list changes reapply position and use delay(0). The owned zone.run encloses reset/state/detection; panelClosingActions is returned afterward, a real structural difference from the parent.
whole_hunk_analysis.bounded_observation: The 22.1.7 AOT fixture checks subscriptions made before input binding, option add/remove/readd, physical selection and same-turn open/destroy/recreate with actual Zone present and genuinely absent. Committed repaired source replay supplies real public zone/render services with protocol collaborators, 10 subject/mode builds and negative controls; it is not actual DI or a proof of every zone ordering. The tagged 16 trigger retains onStable, and the modern refactor is deliberately not transplanted wholesale.
